homeMainText: Tashgiprogor JSC is a leading design institute in Uzbekistan, specializing in the creation of administrative, residential, socio-cultural facilities, historical symbols, and modern spaces that reflect the spirit of the times and the needs of society.
serviceEight: Development of Special Technical Conditions for Unique Buildings and Structures
serviceOneText: Development of architectural solutions that meet modern aesthetic and functional standards.
serviceOneTwoText: Creation of unique facades and interiors, considering the architectural characteristics of the site.
serviceTwoText: Design of load-bearing structures to ensure reliability and durability.
serviceTwoTwoText: Optimization of structural solutions to reduce material costs and enhance building resilience.
serviceThreeText: Water supply and sewerage: Design of water supply and drainage systems.
serviceThreeTwoText: Power supply and electrical equipment: Development of energy supply schemes for buildings.

serviceThreeFourText: Telecommunication networks: Implementation of modern communication solutions.

serviceThreeSixText: Thermal calculations and energy certification: Energy efficiency analysis of buildings.
serviceFourText: Preparation of project and cost estimation documentation in compliance with all regulatory requirements while optimizing construction budgets.
serviceFiveText: Development of solutions for organizing the construction process to minimize timelines and costs.
serviceSixText: Assistance in developing work execution plans (PPR) to ensure high-quality construction work.
serviceSevenText: Diagnosis of load-bearing structures in buildings and facilities.
serviceSevenTwoText: Optimization of project solutions based on inspection results to reduce construction time and expenses.
serviceEightText: The development of Special Technical Conditions (STC) is essential for the design and construction of unique buildings and structures that do not fit within standard norms and regulations. This ensures safety, reliability, and compliance with the specific requirements of the project.
serviceNineText: Author supervision under building codes is the control exercised by the general designer to ensure that construction is carried out strictly in accordance with the approved design. Within this service, the design organisation verifies that the works performed comply with technical requirements and design solutions, monitors quality, identifies deviations and requires that they be eliminated. In case of violations, it has the right to suspend certain types of work until the deficiencies are corrected.
serviceNineTwoText: Author supervision also includes promptly introducing necessary changes into the design documentation when construction conditions change and correcting identified errors to ensure accurate and safe implementation of the project on site.

aboutMainDescLong: The Tashkent State Institute of Urban Planning, Tashgiprogor, established in 1937, is a key player in the architectural development of Tashkent and Uzbekistan. The institute's primary mission is to develop urban planning and design documentation for administrative, residential, cultural, social, and sports facilities that shape the historical and modern image of the capital.
